about: Tecumseh is a town in Essex County, Ontario, on Lake St. Clair immediately east of Windsor. It is a suburban lakeshore community of waterfront parks, newer subdivisions, and a commercial strip along County Road 22. Proximity to Windsor shapes commuting while the lake shore gives the town its own character. About 23,000 people live in Tecumseh.
